data: Amazon's total net sales rose from $574,785 million (about $574.8 billion) in fiscal 2023 to $716,924 million (about $716.9 billion) in fiscal 2025, an increase of $142,139 million. That works out to a gain of roughly 24.7% over the two years. For context, fiscal 2024 net sales were $637,959 million, so the growth came in two steps of about 11.0% in 2024 and 12.4% in 2025.
